description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models on the SEconvo dataset. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," is linear and shows the runtime values for each model. The horizontal axis lists the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The "Our Joint Framework" is represented by a green bar with a runtime of 77 seconds, while the "LLM Models" are represented by sky blue bars with runtimes of 190, 365, 172, and 243 seconds for "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude," respectively. The chart includes a legend that distinguishes between "Our Joint Framework" and "LLM Models." The runtimes are annotated above each bar for clarity. The chart is saved as a high-resolution JPEG image named "8-62116.jpg."
